description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) performance of the MADLLM model and its ablated variants across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The vertical axis represents the F1 Score ranging from 60% to 100%, with tick marks at 10% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in the specified order. For each dataset, four bars are grouped together, representing: MADLLM (green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), MADLLM without prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM without skip embedding (orange). On SMD, all variants perform similarly, with scores around 91–93%. On PSM, MADLLM achieves the highest score (~97%), while the variant without prompt pool drops to ~77%. On SWaT, MADLLM scores ~91%, and the variant without prompt pool drops to ~83%. On SMAP, MADLLM scores ~93%, while the variant without skip embedding drops to ~67%. On MSL, MADLLM scores ~87%, and the variant without prompt pool drops to ~69%. On WADI, MADLLM scores ~74%, while the variant without feature embedding drops sharply to ~62%. The chart visually emphasizes the importance of each component, particularly the prompt pool and feature embedding, as their removal leads to significant performance degradation on most datasets.
